text: Garage Pro. The workshop system built for UAE garages.
A customer pulls in. Search the plate, and their history is already there. Note the complaint, mark any damage, and take a signature, in under two minutes.
Garage Pro builds three estimate options from your price list, and sends them on WhatsApp. The customer approves from their phone.
The approved estimate becomes a job card. Parts are reserved from stock, labour goes to a technician, and every bay is tracked live.
When stock runs low, Garage Pro suggests the order, matches the supplier invoice, and records your input VAT.
At delivery, issue a numbered tax invoice in one click. It's locked, VAT-correct, and ready to print.
For business customers, the e-invoice goes out through Wafeq, in the PINT AE format, built for the UAE e-invoicing rollout.
And every morning, one dashboard shows revenue, open jobs, customer dues, and stock.
Garage Pro. Book your demo today.
